job.value: Decide whether to buy this item

arrivedFrom.value: A listing card on search results or the homepage

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Love Bonito Elda Padded Top' title, 'S$10' price and gallery make it clearly a listing.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The red full-width 'Buy' button in the seller card is the loudest control on screen.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Buy' and 'Add to Cart' say what happens; the breadcrumb links are labelled.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Buyer Protection' and the delivery line 'S$2.50, 3 - 5 days' are familiar to buyers.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only decision is buy or add to cart, with price and delivery cost shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Above the fold is only title, price, delivery and seller rating; the full description sits further down.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: A '728 × 90 ad creative' banner above the breadcrumb pushes the item title and Buy button to the bottom of the first screen.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Title, price and the Buy button carry the decision without any reading.
